source_refs.note: Exercise 12.2, Question 5 (i)-(ii): find m and n for continuity at x = 3 (book p.234); part (ii) has no n. Answer key PDF 310 prints m = 4 for (ii); correct m = 3.

blocks.prompt: 5 (i) Find the values \(m\) and \(n\), so that given function \(f\) is continuous at \(x = 3\): \[f(x) = \begin{cases} mx, & x < 3 \\ n, & x = 3 \\ -2x + 9, & x > 3 \end{cases}\]
blocks.explanation:
Yeh "constants find karo" wala continuity ka sawal hai. Do unknowns hain, \(m\) aur \(n\).
\(x = 3\) par continuity ke liye LHL, RHL aur \(f(3)\) teeno barabar hone chahiyen. Is se do equations banengi, jo do unknowns ke liye kaafi hain.
Plan: pehle RHL nikalein (woh seedha number aata hai), phir LHL aur \(f(3)\) ko usi ke barabar rakhein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(x < 3\) ke liye \(f(x) = mx\), \(f(3) = n\), aur \(x > 3\) ke liye \(f(x) = -2x + 9\).
Humein find karna hai: \(m\) aur \(n\), taake \(f\) point \(x = 3\) par continuous ho.
Tareeqa: Continuity ka matlab: \(\lim_{x \to 3^-} f(x) = \lim_{x \to 3^+} f(x) = f(3)\). Teeno ko ek doosre ke barabar rakhna hai.

Left hand limit nikalein
\[\lim_{x \to 3^-} f(x) = \lim_{x \to 3^-} mx = 3m\]
Kyun: 3 se pehle pehla tukra \(mx\) lagta hai. \(m\) abhi maloom nahi, is liye jawab \(3m\) hi rahega.

Right hand limit nikalein
\[\lim_{x \to 3^+} f(x) = \lim_{x \to 3^+} (-2x + 9)\]
\[= -6 + 9 = 3\]
Kyun: 3 ke baad teesra tukra \(-2x + 9\) lagta hai. Is mein koi unknown nahi, is liye seedha number 3 mil gaya. Yahi number baaqi sab ke liye "target" hai.

Point par value
\[f(3) = n\]
Kyun: Beech wali line batati hai ke bilkul \(x = 3\) par function ki value \(n\) hai.

Teeno ko barabar rakhein
\[3m = 3 \Rightarrow m = 1\]
\[n = 3\]
Kyun: Pehli shart: LHL = RHL, yani \(3m = 3\), dono taraf 3 se divide kiya to \(m = 1\). Doosri shart: \(f(3)\) limit ke barabar ho, yani \(n = 3\).
Dhyan dein: Sirf \(m\) nikaal kar ruk jana ghalti hai; \(n\) ke baghair function \(x = 3\) par continuous nahi banega.

Tasdeeq
\[m = 1:\ \lim_{x \to 3^-} x = 3\]
\[\text{LHL} = \text{RHL} = f(3) = 3\]
Kyun: \(m = 1\) aur \(n = 3\) rakhne se teeno values 3 ban jati hain, is liye continuity ki teeno shartein poori hain.

blocks.prompt: 5 (ii) Find the values \(m\) and \(n\), so that given function \(f\) is continuous at \(x = 3\): \[f(x) = \begin{cases} mx, & x < 3 \\ x^2, & x \ge 3 \end{cases}\]
blocks.explanation:
Yeh bhi constant find karne wala sawal hai, lekin is part mein sirf ek unknown \(m\) hai; question ke stem mein "\(m\) and \(n\)" likha hai magar part (ii) mein \(n\) hai hi nahi.
\(x = 3\) par continuity ke liye LHL, RHL aur \(f(3)\) barabar hone chahiyen.
Plan: \(x^2\) wale tukre se \(f(3)\) aur RHL nikalein, phir LHL \(3m\) ko unke barabar rakhein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(x < 3\) ke liye \(f(x) = mx\), aur \(x \ge 3\) ke liye \(f(x) = x^2\).
Humein find karna hai: \(m\), taake \(f\) point \(x = 3\) par continuous ho.
Tareeqa: Continuity ki shart: \(\lim_{x \to 3^-} f(x) = \lim_{x \to 3^+} f(x) = f(3)\).

Point par value
\[f(3) = 3^2 = 9\]
Kyun: Doosre tukre ke saath \(x \ge 3\) hai, yani 3 isi tukre mein shamil hai. Is liye \(f(3) = 3^2\).

Right hand limit nikalein
\[\lim_{x \to 3^+} f(x) = \lim_{x \to 3^+} x^2 = 9\]
Kyun: 3 ke baad bhi wahi \(x^2\) wala tukra chalta hai, is liye RHL bhi 9.

Left hand limit nikalein
\[\lim_{x \to 3^-} f(x) = \lim_{x \to 3^-} mx = 3m\]
Kyun: 3 se pehle \(mx\) wala tukra lagta hai; \(m\) maloom nahi, is liye \(3m\).

Barabar rakh kar solve karein
\[3m = 9\]
\[m = \frac{9}{3} = 3\]
Kyun: LHL ko RHL aur \(f(3)\) dono ke barabar hona hai, jo 9 hain. Dono taraf 3 se divide karne par \(m = 3\).
Dhyan dein: \(3m = 9\) se \(m = 3\) aata hai; jaldi mein \(9 - 3\) ya koi aur hisaab lagane se ghalat value nikalti hai.

Tasdeeq
\[m = 3:\ \lim_{x \to 3^-} 3x = 9\]
\[\text{LHL} = \text{RHL} = f(3) = 9\]
Kyun: \(m = 3\) rakhne se teeno 9 hain, continuity poori. Agar \(m = 4\) lete to LHL 12 hota, jo 9 ke barabar nahi, yani function toot jata.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein "(ii) \(m = 4\)" likha hai. Yeh ghalat hai: \(x = 3\) par continuity ke liye \(3m = 3^2 = 9\) chahiye, is liye \(m = 3\). \(m = 4\) lene se left hand limit 12 banti hai, jo \(f(3) = 9\) ke barabar nahi.
